description: This file defines the UsageListAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying app usage statistics, including package name, last time used, and app icon.

classes.name: UsageListAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass that provides views for displaying app usage statistics.

classes.name: UsageListAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class holding references to views for package name, last time used, and app icon.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances by inflating the usage_row layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a given position, setting package name, last time used, and app icon.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the usage stats list.

methods.name: setCustomUsageStatsList
methods.description: Sets the list of CustomUsageStats objects to be displayed.
